blocks.source_excerpt: void initialize(void) { a=b=c=d=k=l=r=bad=0; enabled=1; a=1; b=0; }
blocks.correspondence: Initial state set by initialize(): all listed variables are zeroed, enabled is set to 1, then a is set to 1 and b to 0.
The interrupt handler copies a into b.
First indivisible foreground STEP assigns count() to c.

blocks.source_excerpt: STEP(1, { if(c>0) { d=count(); bad=(d==0); if(!bad) r=12/d; } });
blocks.correspondence: Second indivisible foreground STEP conditionally computes d, marks bad when d is zero, and otherwise assigns 12/d to r.
